segments.contextAfter: `item`: A binding to an optional source of truth for the action sheet. When `item` is non-`nil`, the system passes the contents to the modifier’s closure. You use this content to populate the fields of an action sheet that you create that the system displays to the user. If `item` changes, the system dismisses the currently displayed action sheet and replaces it with a new one using the same process.
